title: Comeback Handaxe
summary: This +1 handaxe returns to inventory after a throw and can damage the thrower.

fields.Homing drawback: On the return, the axe can hit the thrower for 1d6 + 1 Bludgeoning. Blocking the return path can avoid damage while the axe still returns. It returns to inventory without equipping itself.
fields.Acquisition: Akabi can award this consolation prize at the Circus of the Last Days.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence.
